description.en: The ID of the resource group. You can obtain the resource group ID in the **Resource Management** console.

description.zh:
前端监控应用类型，包括：

- `web`：Web页面
- `weex`：Weex页面
- `mini_dd`：钉钉小程序
- `mini_alipay`：支付宝小程序
- `mini_wx`：微信小程序
- `mini_common`：其他小程序
description.en:
The type of the application. Valid values:

*   `web`: web application
*   `weex`: Weex mobile app
*   `mini_dd`: DingTalk mini program
*   `mini_alipay`: Alipay mini program
*   `mini_wx`: WeChat mini program
*   `mini_common`: mini program on other platforms
The tags that you want to add to the task.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun arms create-retcode-app --retcode-app-name SdkTest --retcode-app-type mini_dd --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --resource-group-id rg-acfmxyexli20000 --tags Value=TestValue Key=TestKey --api-version 2019-08-08 --region cn-hangzhou
